history.title: Clipboard History

history.noMatchesDescription: No entries match the current filters
history.emptyDescription: Copied content will appear here automatically

history.migrationWarningSuffix: history entries. They remain preserved and will be retried on the next start.

history.preview.title: History preview
history.preview.error: This history item could not be previewed
history.preview.docxDescription: DOCX files are opened with the system app after you restore them.
history.preview.unsupported: This file type cannot be previewed here.

history.preview.corrupt: This item is damaged or has an invalid format
history.preview.unavailable: The stored content is no longer available
history.preview.rendererError: This preview could not be rendered

history.preview.imageBudget: Image omitted to stay within the preview memory budget
history.preview.imageAvailability.missin: The saved image data is missing
The document did not provide image bytes

history.preview.imageAvailability.unsupp: This image format is not supported in the preview
history.preview.imageAvailability.pixel_: The image exceeds the preview pixel budget
history.preview.partial.limit: Only part of the content is shown because it reached a preview limit.

history.preview.partial.malformed: Some markup was not displayed because it is malformed or unsupported.
